title: White isn’t a good color for a kitchen mat!
text: White isn’t a good color for a kitchen mat!. Within 2 days this looked terribly dingy and old. The construction is perfectly fine. It’s also tapered so you don’t trip on it. It’s wide enough to provide true support. Just, the color needs to be re-thought. Bummer!!
